route-has-navigation.reason: Expo Router treats app/error.tsx as a route, but the module exports a Next.js-shaped ErrorBoundary({error, retry}) that no navigation targets. Owned by the mobile wave; declared so no NEW unreachable route can land.

Expo Router treats app/error.tsx as a route, but the module exports a Next.js-shaped ErrorBoundary({error, retry}) that no navigation targets. Owned by the mobile wave; declared so no NEW unreachable route can land.

Expo Router treats the group's error.tsx as a route, but it is a file-convention error boundary the router renders on a thrown error; nothing navigates to it. Added so a failure during sign-in, onboarding or the age gate recovers locally instead of falling through to the root boundary.
